children.title: Life and death
bullets: Art. 124 — not heard of for 7 years

title: Examination of a witness — Arts. 132 to 161

steps.title: Oath and competence
steps.text: Competence (Art. 3); oath or affirmation; video link if allowed (Art. 164)

steps.title: Examination-in-chief
steps.text: By the party calling; no leading questions on disputed matters

steps.title: Cross-examination
steps.text: By the adverse party; leading questions; previous statements; credit

steps.title: Re-examination
steps.text: To explain matters in cross; new matter only with leave

steps.title: If hostile
steps.text: Court may permit cross-examination by the party calling; impeach credit with consent

steps.title: Court's questions
steps.text: Any question, any time; judgment only on relevant, proved facts
